title: [bundle] Fix audit-found no-conflict agent navigation gap: `hf lease
objective: Fix audit-found no-conflict agent navigation gap: `hf lease --json` still reports held leases for tasks already Done (`TASK-E88691-0001` and `TASK-429729-0001`). Completion/release must clear or hide stale/expired in-ledger claim leases so agents do not see false active holders/conflicts after work is done. Add regression coverage and prove `hf lease --json` has no held Done-task leases after completion.
acceptance_criteria: `hf done <ID>` appends an in-ledger lease release for the completed claim resource and removes the lockfile mirror.
`hf lease --json` no longer reports held leases for terminal Done/Review task resources, preventing false active-holder/conflict signals.
A CLI regression test proves a claimed task is visible before done and absent from held leases after done.
Existing Done-task leases are cleared or hidden so the current workspace reports no held leases for Done tasks.
test_commands: hf lease --json | jq -e '(.held // []) | all(.resource | test("TASK-E88691-0001|TASK-429729-0001") | not)'
